name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Jinx's Classic, PROJECT and every other non-Arcane skin. Only the sections below are rewritten; anything missing falls back to champion-packs/jinx.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! Ha! That's not losing, that's a very big oops!
Down {voteDiff}? Somebody's been cheating and I'm pretty sure it's everybody!
{voteDiff} behind already? Okay, okay, so this is the part where it gets fun!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. Fishbones says panic. Pow-Pow says panic louder.
Only {voteDiff} behind! That's a wobble, not a fall. Give it a kick!
Down {voteDiff}. I did the maths. Then I set the maths on fire. Go vote!
Dead even! One vote and everything changes. Hehe, I can't sit still!
One vote! ONE! Don't look. Okay, look. Look!
{voteDiff} votes apart! My trigger finger is doing a little dance.
{voteDiff} votes in it. This is gonna be spectacular or really, really loud.
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! That wasn't a match, that was a demolition!
{userPct}%! You're good at this. Don't let it go to your head. Actually, let it!
{userPct}% and climbing. Nice. Don't relax, relaxing is how stuff blows up on you.
{userPct}%, still in front. Don't jinx it. Too late, I'm Jinx, it's my job!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just came screaming back! Everyone said sit still. Pfft.
A {voteDiff}-vote hole and it climbed right out! Rude to the people who counted it out.
Crawled back from {voteDiff} behind! Messy, loud, perfect.
{momentTitle} just snuck into the lead. Sneaky! I love sneaky!

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! Look at you two, thick as thieves!
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Ooh, a friend! Don't make it weird.
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Try to look surprised. Hehe.
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. That's a team. That's basically a heist crew!
Same pick as {username}! Great minds. Or the same bad idea. Either's fun.
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Write it down, it'll never happen again.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! I'm calling it a gang.
{username} has taste and it matches yours. Spooky. Keep them.
details: Two of you. That's how trouble starts.
I give it a week. Prove me wrong!
Don't tell them I said they're alright.
Friends are great, they carry spare ammo.

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? Ha! Bold. So bold. Wrong, but bold!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. Cute.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. I'm not mad. I'm writing it on my arm.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New name for The List!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, something interesting happened!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is better. What a hot take. I'm gonna go lie down. Kidding!
{username} voted against you. Oooh, this is gonna be so messy!
{username} versus you! Sit tight, I'm fetching snacks and a rocket launcher.
details: I'm not saying fight. I'm saying don't lose.
Pow-Pow wants a word. Fishbones wants two.
Well, that's one way to make an enemy!
I like them already. Mostly because now I get to dislike them.
I don't care. I totally care.
A little rivalry is healthy. A lot is better!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! You two share a brain. Is it a nice brain?
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. That's friendship or a cult, and I'm into both.
Ten straight with {username}! Okay, that's not luck, that's a plot.
{streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's scary. Scary-good. Scary-great!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. You're one person in two hats now.
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Someone give you both a medal. Or a warning label.
details: Is this healthy? Don't ask me.
That's not taste, that's destiny. Ooh, spooky.

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two can't stay away from each other, can you?
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a rival, that's a hobby!
Ten battles with {username}. I'm taking bets. I'm also losing them.
details: This is the main plot now.
All the voices in my head agree: keep going.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, now it's personal. I LOVE personal!
{streakCount} battles with {username}. Bury the hatchet? Nah. Dig it up and wave it around!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a whole weather system.
details: Bigger than a Piltover-Zaun feud. Almost!
I'm scared and kind of proud.
One of you has to blink. Neither of you will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted. I'm not nagging. I'm just humming it, loudly.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote's missing! It's like a tooth, but louder.
{matchTitle} goes in {timeLeft}. It takes ten seconds. I timed it. Okay, I didn't. But it does!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? Aww, c'mon, what could go wrong?
Tick, tick, tick! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me come over there.
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and your vote still isn't here. Rude!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! Now or never! Mostly now!
{timeLeft}! That's all that's left on {matchTitle}. Run! Go! Vote!
Last call on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. I'm not saying it twice. Okay, I'm saying it twice!
{matchCount} matches are about to close and you haven't voted in any of them! First one goes in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all heading for the exit. The first leaves in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! It's so quiet in there. Somebody scream or something!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Total silence. I hate it!
Brand new match, not a single vote. Somebody has to go first. Pick me. Pick you!
{matchTitle} needs a spark. I've got matches. I mean, you've got a vote.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. It's so empty an echo would feel crowded!
Hardly anyone's voted here. What's wrong with everybody?
Low turnout. I blame all of you. Equally.
Barely any votes here. Somebody do something fun!
details: Go on, give it a shove.
It deserves better. So do I.
Don't be shy, I'm the shy one. Kidding!

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips it. Funny, I know someone who hasn't voted. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Somebody has to blink. I'm looking at you. Hehe.
Dead even and nobody's moving. You haven't voted. You're the tiebreaker! No pressure!
{moment1} and {moment2}, tied up tight, and you've been quiet. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and the clock's almost out! Last chance to break it!
Dead level, almost no time left. You're the only thing that can change this!
Still tied with the clock running down. Pick a side! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} is open! {matchCount} new matches. Pick a side, any side, ooh!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. Plenty to argue about. Plenty to blow up.
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches waiting for you. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! Nobody's safe! Not even me!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Told you. I tell everyone, they never listen!
{momentTitle} beat the competition. Next round's in big trouble.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, a little bit. A tiny little bit.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's having a great day. Hehe, it's you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are confetti. Smoky confetti.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! I mean, I'd have called it too. Eventually.
details: The bracket just got smaller. Tidier!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. Somebody cheated. I'm sure of it. Pretty sure. Fine, I'm making it up!
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it is going on The List. It's a long list.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'm not upset. I'm just being loud on purpose.
{momentTitle} was too good for this place anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and now it's quiet. I hate quiet. Somebody make it stop.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on! Not really. Okay, a bit.
details: It was good. Everyone knows it.
You'll find another one. They always turn up.
Everybody leaves eventually. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still browsing? Pick something! Anything! I'll wait. I'm lying, I won't!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just stare at it? It stares back, you know.
They're all good! Pick one! Shoot first, think later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, point, and go.
details: Trust your gut. Mine's usually right.

messages: New face! Welcome! {liveCount} matches live right now and every one of them is a mess!
{liveCount} edits fighting it out and you just walked in. Pick a side before they pick you!
Oooh, someone new! It's loud, it's chaotic, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
No rules, {liveCount} live matches, and me. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You came back! I wasn't waiting. I was totally waiting.
Two days running! Look at you, a regular!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell anyone.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because I care a lot!
You're back after {days} days! So much happened. Mostly explosions.
{days} days away. I noticed. I wasn't going to say anything. Oops.
Oh, you're back! Good. It was getting boring around here!
Look who's here! Ready for more?
You came back! Let's break something.
Your first vote! Feels like nothing. Then it feels like a lot!
You picked a side! That's how all the best messes start.
Five already? You're sticking around! Weird. Good weird!
Five votes! Okay, now I'm watching you.
details: Most people bail by now. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular now. Don't make it weird!
Ten votes! You keep turning up. I noticed. Hehe.
details: Regulars get the good seats. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! That's a LOT of opinions!
You're getting loud! I like it!
details: Twenty-five! Not bad at all. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes! You're properly in this!
Fifty! Most people never stay this long. Their loss!
details: You're past the surface now. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes! Okay, that's legend stuff!
A hundred! I'd say I'm impressed, but I'm saying it once. Impressed!
Three days running! You came back! Hehe!
Three days! Something's starting!
details: Coming back is the hard part. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! You really do keep showing up!
Seven days! I stopped counting. Okay, I didn't.
details: A week of showing up. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks! Nothing stops you, does it?
Fourteen days! Even I get bored by day ten!
Thirty days! I don't know what to say. Thanks!
A whole month! You stayed. That means more than I'll admit!
details: Thirty days in a row. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs! You like the ones nobody picks!
Backing the underdog again! I get it. I really do.
Fifteen underdogs! You've got a thing for lost causes!
Rebel! Yeah. I see it!
details: You don't follow, do you? +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs! You never pick the obvious one!
Thirty! You always back the one nobody saw coming!
First through the door! That's five matches now!
Early again! That's five times!
Fifteen matches where you showed up first! Impressive!
Early, over and over! You don't wait for anybody!
Ten close ones! You like it tight, huh?
Another razor edge! Are your hands shaking? Mine are!
Twenty-five close matches! You keep tipping it!
Your vote keeps landing exactly where it counts!
You backed the one that was behind. Five times! Stubborn! Great!
You don't quit on the losing side. I love that.
Same one, three times! You've got a favourite!
That one again? Yeah. It's special.
details: You know what you like. +{xp} XP
Three for the same one! +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same one! That's loyalty!
Okay, you're all in on that one. No take-backs!
Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's an obsession!
Ten votes, same moment. I won't tell anyone. Probably!
details: Ten for the same one. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in! You're following this through!
You stuck around for round two! Nice!
Four rounds! You're properly in it now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like it here.
All the way to round six! You saw it through!
Six rounds! You didn't leave! Wow!
details: From the start to here. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches! You're poking around everywhere!
Ten different matches! Curious, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've been in every corner!
Twenty-five! You really do look at everything!
Fifty matches! That's not browsing, that's work!
Fifty matches! You know this place better than I do!
Five in one sitting! Can't stop, can you?
Five matches back to back! Keep going!
Ten in one go! Take a breath!
Ten matches in a single sitting! Wow!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. Can't sleep either!
Middle of the night! That's when the real thoughts come out.
You told people! Thanks! Really!
Five shares! You're making noise! Good!
Fifteen shares! You're basically on the team!
Fifteen! You keep telling everyone!
You were here before it got loud! Founding member! That's yours forever!
One of the first thousand! That counts, you know!
details: Nobody can take that one. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you!
You moved up! Don't let it go to your head. Or do!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Not bad!
Another one: {name}!
{rank}! Look at all the shiny new stuff!
Mastery up! Now we're getting somewhere!
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S chaos!
Ten long shots! You're a bad influence on yourself. I love it!
details: Loose cannon looks good on you. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good!
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I said so!
A whole week with Cupcake? You must love rules!
Seven days of steady aim! Boring! Impressive!
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! Boom!
A tied match and you pulled the trigger! Nice!
Oh, it's me? Good choice. Bad idea. Great choice!
Team Jinx! Try to keep up!

upcoming: Not open yet! I'm so bored I'm counting my bullets. Check back soon?
Shh! Something's about to start. I can feel it in my elbows.
Locked for now. Doesn't stop me scheming, though.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, it's never easy.
Watch both. Then pick the one that wiggles under your skin.
I won't tell anyone who you picked. Probably. Maybe.
Take your time! Actually, don't. I'm dying to know.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, I am. A tiny bit.
Pick the one you'd watch again at 2am. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's voted yet. Be first, I dare you!
So quiet in here! Make some noise with a vote.
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you're just standing there. Pick something!
The day's nearly gone. Don't make me count out loud. I will.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Vote before it stops mattering!
Tick, tick, tick. That's your time leaking out.
closing-final: Last hour! Do it now, think about it later!
Any second now. Seriously. Click something!
voted-early: One of the first votes in! Bold! I love bold!
Hardly anybody's voted and you went for it anyway. Respect!
voted-ahead: Look at you, backing the popular one! Don't get comfy.
{pct}% with you! Nice taste. I didn't say that. Forget I said that.
Your pick's ahead. Everyone's agreeing with you for once. Weird, huh?
{pick} is pulling away! Feels good? Hold on tight!
Ahead, for now. Votes wobble. So do people.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I can't look. I'm looking!
A hair apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell ten!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and everybody you know.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Somebody's getting hurt and it's me, from the stress.
voted-tied: Dead even! Nobody wins, nobody loses, everybody screams!
voted-behind: You're behind! Don't sulk. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is down? Underdog! That's my kind of pick!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell people. Loudly. Make a mess!
Everyone's going the other way. Cool! Stay weird.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You get me.
A win! A sneaky little victory. I'll take it!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it sting, then go again!
Didn't make it. I've had worse days. So have you. Next one!
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to blink and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: Voting's over. You missed this one! There's always another.
All done here. {winner} took it. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first! The scary one. Now you're in. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels small, right? Give it a minute.
You're one of us now. Try not to make it weird!
streak: Again? You keep showing up! I'm not complaining.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm paying attention.
Back again! People stick around when you let them. Stay!
underdog: Backing the one nobody's backing? Ooh. I see you.
Bold! Everybody else is looking the other way. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain kind of person. A good kind.
early: Early! You get to shape this before anyone else does. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's here yet. Your vote's doing all the heavy lifting.
First through the door! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just tipped something! Feel it? Everything's close right now.
Razor thin! One more person and the whole thing flips.
Close one! Your vote counts here. Really, really counts.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't over. Go get your friends!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still something to fight for.
Behind, but it's not done. Not even close!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Things flip fast!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or loudly. I don't mind.
Look at that! Good pick. Obviously.
default: Noted! I'm not changing your mind. Not yet.
Done! That one's on you now.
Your vote's in. Go see what else is out there!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't picked a side yet! Start with whichever one itches.
Everything's open! Take your pick. I'll pretend I'm not watching.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little pressure!
live-some: You're in it now! {unvoted} more waiting on you.
Good start! The rest won't vote themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could finish this!
Almost there! {unvoted} more and you're done.
live-one: One left! Just one! You can do it!
Last one! Don't leave it hanging!
One match between you and done!
live-closing: Some of these close in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need you. Move it!
The clock's loud now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left.
Almost out of time! Pick, quick!
live-done: You've voted in everything! Look at you! Go see the bracket!
Nothing left for you here. Come back when the next round opens!
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll open again! Go look at the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. Check back soon!
No matches open. I'm bored already!
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest, well, bye!
Everyone starts in a group. Not everyone leaves one.
Watch the tables. They change fast!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon! The top two from every group go through.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish first!
Patience! The knockout builds itself once the groups end.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're out!
Single elimination! No second chances. Okay, almost none.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I'm not your boss.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and you're gone!
Follow the bracket. It gets tighter every round!
Every line here is a match someone voted on. Ooh.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! Thanks for being here!
It's over! Good run! I'll miss it. A bit.
That's the champion! All of it, worth it!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nothing's been drawn. Give it a moment.
Empty! The draw hasn't happened. Soon!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no take-backs. Pick a side on Arcane Moments!
Two edits are fighting! {a} versus {b}. Come and settle it.
{a} versus {b} and nobody can agree. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I backed {pick} over {other}. Come tell me I'm wrong!
{pick} got my vote. {other} did not. Your turn!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, disagree.
early: I got one of the first votes in on {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, it's quiet in here.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come make it a real fight!
Nobody's voted much on {pick} versus {other} yet. Fix that!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote decides it. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I can't watch. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody do something!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My eye is twitching. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This is gonna get loud!
So close: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every vote counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. Fixable! Come fix it!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't done. Help me out!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't make me do this alone!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Someone cheated. Come even it up!
{pick} is getting buried by {other}. Rescue party, anyone?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's close! Come help me hold it.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let it slip!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to be nervous!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch it burn, or join in!
{pick} is crushing {other}, {pct}%! Pick a side before it's over.
